description: Give exactly one of check_id (a check's history) or device (when its configuration last changed)

check_id.description: The check whose status to follow across snapshots. Give exactly one of check_id and device.

device.description: The device whose configuration to follow across snapshots (when its config last changed). Give exactly one of check_id and device.

snapshots.description: How many of the newest processed, collected snapshots to read (default 8, at most 20).
